title: fields/index.json
description: Index of HUD field PNGs (F18, F21). Each PNG is 8-bit RGBA, value = (R*256 + G) * scale, B = 0, A = 255 valid / 0 unknown (contracts/README.md). Index file: requires "dummy". v1.1.1: optional per-entry grid (bounds, width, height, res_m) and stencil for fields on their own grid: the way-home pointer fields/{scenario}/pointer.png (WS7 proposal, WS2 pointer on the native 3 m route grid; scale 1, units "move").

dummy.description: true only in web/public/data-dummy/; must be false in web/public/data/

scenario.description: scenario id, or null for shared fields (e.g. slope)

bounds.description: [w, s, e, n] lon/lat deg of this entry's own grid (outer pixel edges); absent = the index's top-level grid (v1.1.1)

width.description: px of this entry's own grid (v1.1.1)

height.description: px of this entry's own grid (v1.1.1)

res_m.description: m per px of this entry's own grid, e.g. 3 for the pointer (v1.1.1)

stencil.description: pointer only: move k (the PNG count) -> [drow, dcol]; next pixel = (row + drow, col + dcol), rows grow southwards; A = 0 = no move (pad or unreached). From WS2 engine/pointer_offsets.json (v1.1.1)
